paper_record.title: Phase-Controlled Epitaxy and Anisotropic Antiferromagnetism of Polar Wurtzite MnTe
paper_record.abstract: Altermagnetic spintronics requires materials in which compensated magnetic order, symmetry-controlled electronic responses, and epitaxial tunability can be combined in experimentally accessible thin films. MnTe is a key material in this context, but experimental studies have focused mainly on the stable NiAs-type polymorph, whereas the polar wurtzite phase remains largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate molecular-beam epitaxy growth and investigate properties of nearly phase-pure wurtzite MnTe deposited directly on GaAs(111)B, and show that small changes in the growth conditions strongly modify the phase composition, from a multiphase state with endotaxial NiAs-type inclusions embedded in wurtzite MnTe matrix to an almost single-phase polar wurtzite layer.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文实现了极性纤锌矿结构MnTe薄膜的相位控制外延生长，并证实了其具有各向异性的反铁磁性。
one_sentence_summary.en: This work demonstrates the phase-controlled epitaxial growth of polar wurtzite MnTe thin films and establishes their anisotropic antiferromagnetism.

problem.zh: 缺乏高相纯度的极性纤锌矿结构MnTe外延薄膜，限制了对其潜在交错磁性及对称性控制响应的研究。
problem.en: The lack of high-phase-purity epitaxial thin films of polar wurtzite MnTe limits the study of its potential altermagnetic and symmetry-controlled properties.

approach.zh: 利用分子束外延技术在GaAs(111)B衬底上直接生长MnTe，通过微调生长温度抑制NiAs型杂相，并结合X射线衍射、透射电镜和SQUID磁强计进行结构与磁学表征。
approach.en: Grew MnTe directly on GaAs(111)B using molecular beam epitaxy, suppressed the NiAs-type secondary phase by tuning the growth temperature, and characterized the films using X-ray diffraction, transmission electron microscopy, and SQUID magnetometry.

main_takeaway.zh: 成功制备出近单相的纤锌矿MnTe薄膜，确定其为反铁磁半导体（奈尔温度约为58 K），并在转变温度以下表现出明显的磁各向异性。
main_takeaway.en: Successfully fabricated nearly single-phase wurtzite MnTe films, identifying them as antiferromagnetic semiconductors with a Neel temperature of approximately 58 K and distinct magnetic anisotropy below this transition.

why_it_matters.zh: 为探索纤锌矿锰硫族化合物中竞争磁结构、交错磁性及多铁性提供了理想的实验平台。
why_it_matters.en: It provides an ideal experimental platform for exploring competing magnetic configurations, altermagnetism, and multiferroicity in wurtzite Mn chalcogenides.

reason.zh: 首次实现了高相纯度纤锌矿MnTe薄膜的直接外延生长，并定量表征了其低温反铁磁转变与各向异性。
reason.en: First demonstration of direct epitaxial growth of high-phase-purity wurtzite MnTe thin films and quantitative characterization of their low-temperature antiferromagnetic transition and anisotropy.

reason.zh: 该研究展示了新型自旋电子学材料的制备与磁学表征，符合该期刊对功能材料及器件应用的定位。
reason.en: The study presents the fabrication and magnetic characterization of a novel spintronic material, fitting the journal's focus on functional materials and device applications.
